name: Amazing Adventure

controls.desktop: WASD walk, mouse look, Shift run, E interact, J journal, Esc pause, P adaptive resolution
controls.touch: left thumb analog stick, right thumb look drag, on-screen Talk/Journal/Pause

notes: Static files only. Serve the repository root over HTTP; ES modules need a directory index.
No runtime dependency on node_modules and no network requests to third-party origins.
Three.js r160 is vendored under vendor/ (MIT).
